description: This file defines the 'SugarFieldHandler' class which manages the handling, retrieval, fixation, and display of different SugarCRM field types, including loading appropriate field classes based on field type and generating Smarty template code for displaying fields in various views.

classes.name: SugarFieldHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for managing SugarCRM's field types, including fixing field types, retrieving field objects, and rendering Smarty templates based on field definitions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the SugarFieldHandler class, currently empty.

methods.name: fixupFieldType
methods.description: Converts specific field type identifiers to standardized types, such as 'double' or 'decimal' to 'float', 'varchar' to 'base', etc.

methods.name: getSugarField
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a singleton instance of the appropriate SugarField class based on the given field type, handling the logic to find the class PHP file.

methods.name: displaySmarty
methods.description: Generates Smarty template code for displaying a field, selecting the appropriate SugarField class and method based on display type and field definitions.
